title: The pup against the stone
logline: The pup asleep in February sun with his back against the stone face's cheek, the moss for a pillow. The face and the dog at the same scale for once. The page gives them the same line.

panels.composition: A small three-legged dog asleep in thin February sun with its back against the cheek of the moss-grown carved stone face, the grass, the shingle wall.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small three-legged dog asleep in thin February sun with its back against the cheek of a moss-grown carved stone face in grass by a shingle wall, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
